subject: Re: Evaluation materials — MAP, usage constraints, and close timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@acme.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation dataset handoff + MAP kickoff

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is excited about the performance profile. Procurement asked me to start the MAP and share the sample inventory so Legal can vet usage constraints. Attached is a small CSV with 1,200 representative IDs (acme-eval-sample-list.csv).

Key asks from our side:
- Non-production use only (no model re-training or derivative dataset re-distribution).
- Data deletion window: samples to be purged after 90 days from provisioning unless we agree to an extension.
- Results sharing: Acme retains the right to receive logs and model outputs tied to these samples for evaluation, subject to redaction of PII.

Can Redwood propose a MAP with milestones and a close timeline (we're targeting a go/no-go decision by Dec 15). Also cc'ing procurement (procurement@acme.ai) for contract coordination.

Attachments: acme-eval-sample-list.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

Best,
Sarah
Sr. Product Manager, Evaluation Programs
Acme AI
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@acme.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset handoff + MAP kickoff

Hi Sarah — thanks for the CSV and the clear asks. I've drafted a short MAP and attached a working PDF (redwood-mpa-draft-v2.pdf) that outlines milestones, roles, and the proposed timeline toward the Dec 15 decision. High-level summary below:

Proposed MAP (summary)
- T+0 (Today): Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox access and ingests the provided sample list.
- T+3 business days: Initial evaluation run; Redwood shares tokenized, redacted output samples back to Acme for QA.
- T+10 business days: Two follow-up runs to validate stability and edge-case behavior.
- T+14 business days: Joint go/no-go meeting to review quality metrics and cost/latency charts.
- Post-decision: If go — discuss longer-term reserved capacity and license terms; if no-go — both parties agree on secure deletion of samples.

Usage constraints we propose to include in the MAP:
- No retraining or model weight updates using the supplied samples.
- Aggregated benchmarks and anonymized logs can be retained for platform improvement; raw sample contents will be purged after 90 days unless extension is mutually agreed.
- Access limited to named sandbox users (we'll create accounts and an ephemeral bucket).

I'm including Marissa to coordinate the technical ingestion and Vivek to scope commercial/credit terms if we need a short pilot discount. Can you confirm if the 90-day purge is acceptable and whether procurement prefers a redline to our standard MPA or a separate MSA?

Attachment: redwood-mpa-draft-v2.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Park <sarah@acme.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset handoff + MAP kickoff

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 11:34 AM neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'm including Marissa to coordinate the technical ingestion and Vivek to scope commercial/credit terms if we need a short pilot discount.

Thanks Neha — 90 days for raw sample purge is acceptable as a starting point. A couple of clarifications from our side before procurement submits formal redlines:
- For auditability we need a short report showing which samples were used in each run (ID + timestamp). That can be pseudonymized.
- We cannot accept any retention of full raw samples past the purge window, even if anonymized, unless there's explicit written approval from Acme.
- We'd prefer the MAP be an amendment to the existing MSA (less friction for procurement).

On the test-case format: we can provide two JSON-formatted test cases per sample (prompt + expected high-level outcome). Is that format okay for Redwood's ingestion?

Appreciate the speed — Sarah
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@acme.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset handoff + MAP kickoff

Hi Sarah — quick technical and commercial notes:

Technical:
- JSON test-cases (prompt + expected outcome) are perfect; please use UTF-8 and include a single header row/manifest so our ingestion job can map IDs. We'll spin up an ephemeral S3 sandbox and provide credentials by EOD Tue.
- We'll provide a small SDK and a validation script to run locally against the sample set to sanity-check formatting.

Commercial:
- For the 2-week evaluation window we can offer a $5k pilot credit against usage. If Acme wants reserved capacity after go, we can then switch to a committed monthly rate.
- I'll share a short pricing addendum for pilot terms; Marissa will help with billing touchpoints.

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-eval-sandbox-spec (ingestion spec + manifest template)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset handoff + MAP kickoff — confirmed next steps

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed next steps and owners so we can close the MAP quickly: 

1) Acme (Sarah / procurement): send JSON test-case files + final sample CSV (manifest) by end of day Wed (Dec 2).
2) Redwood (Marissa): provision ephemeral S3 sandbox and credentials by Wed EOD; provide ingestion SDK and validation script.
3) Redwood (Neha): formalize the MAP as an amendment to the existing MSA and circulate for redline; include 90-day purge clause and pseudonymized per-run usage report.
4) Redwood (Vivek): send pilot credit addendum ($5k) and short pricing note; Marissa to coordinate billing onboarding.
5) Joint: schedule go/no-go review meeting week of Dec 14; proposed time Dec 15 10:00 AM PT.

Docs/Links: HubSpot deal ACME-2026-MAP-42 — https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/ACME-2026-MAP-42
DocuSign (for MAP amend once redlines settled): https://docusign.redwood.ai/link/ACME-MAP-42

If that matches Acme's timeline we'll treat Dec 15 as the decision milestone and aim to have the pilot fully runnable before then. Sarah — can you confirm the Dec 2 artifact delivery and the Dec 15 meeting time?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
